basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old automotive enthusiast based in Los Angeles, California. My passion for cars started in my teenage years and has only grown since then. I work as a mechanical engineer specializing in automotive design, which gives me a unique perspective on the vehicles I love. During my downtime, I enjoy exploring the latest video games, particularly indie titles, and discussing them in online forums. I'm a night owl, often online after 9 PM PST. I'm single, focusing on my career and hobbies at the moment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from UC Berkeley. My professional experience includes working with automotive companies where I've contributed to the design and testing of vehicle components. I supplement my formal education with self-teaching through online courses and forums to stay updated with the latest in automotive technology.
